answer: Each identity locks 70 in haven custody and earns standing in three milestones, each checked by a different zephyr verifier staking 20 and signing the work. One verifier may sign six milestones per epoch, so a farm cannot reuse one verifier. The k-th fake costs 115, 70 locked plus 45 fees, and 1,000 fakes need 500 verifiers at 120 onboarding each, 60,000 extra. A ring approving the same work twice fails: the ember ledger records each signed milestone hash once, and a second use burns the bond and slashes the stake. An honest identity pays 115 once and recovers its 70 at milestone three.
